title: LADA Blue Wings vs Ugly Pucklings, Sep 20
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie A (the 3840x1536 strip camera): we wore white and had the left (home) bench. Detection on the Windows PC at 38 fps after the process.py pipe fix.

Periods, goals and shots come from the arena scoreboard (we were HOME): periods 0:18-18:18, 19:55-38:17 and 39:48-65:36 of the video, by the clock. The video runs to the final horn. Goals at 6:48 (ours), 14:11 and 14:50 (Ugly Pucklings) and 51:02 (ours) of the video, at clock 11:27, 4:06, 3:28 (1st) and 8:50 (3rd), as the team gave them. Shots on goal: Blue Wings 25, Ugly Pucklings 32.

One penalty, ours: Belousenko #11, 2:00 at 2:38 of the 3rd (whistle 60:19 of the video); the home panel showed it and #11 sat in the near-side box until 64:57. The clip follows #11; the infraction looks like a stick up high at 60:10 near an opponent who went over the boards at our bench at 60:12.

Played: 14 skaters. Lisenko #55 arrived during the 2nd period (first seen about 30:47 of the video); the reviewers were first told she had not played, so the rows that could be her were re-checked. Didn't play: Skitsko #16, Trunov #35, Horokh #77. Dukhno #50 played in a borrowed jersey with the DERKACHEV nameplate.

Goal at 51:02: a line change was on, and Miroshnichenko #43 was reaching our bench as the puck went in, so six are listed on the ice. Short lineup gaps remain: P2 28:46-29:01 and P3 43:16-43:32 (6 on), P3 53:52-54:14 (4 on).
